# KettlebellJournal

> > A fitness app for tracking kettlebell and strength training workouts, monitoring progress, and achieving training goals.

KettlebellJournal is a mobile workout tracker designed specifically for kettlebell enthusiasts and strength training athletes. The app helps users log workouts, track progress over time, and set fitness goals with a focus on kettlebell-specific movements and training programs.

## Key Topics

- kettlebell training
- workout tracking
- strength training
- fitness app
- progress tracking
- mobile app
- beta signup

- workout logging
- exercise tracking
